title: TRIAD: Benchmarking Omni-Modal Ambiguity in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambiguity is a central feature of natural communication: a sentence, image, or sound may remain underspecified until evidence from the other channels is considered. Yet current multimodal benchmarks mostly test perception, recognition, or reasoning over already determinate inputs, leaving unclear whether omni-modal large language models can resolve ambiguity distributed across text, vision, and audio. We introduce TRIAD, a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution. Each item is a text--image--audio triplet paired with a question and a set of answer options, and is constructed so that the full triplet determines a unique answer while removing any one modality makes the set of consistent options non-unique. TRIAD contains $327$ hand-written queries in $86$ scene groups and covers $18$ ambiguity categories across the three modalities. translated_title: TRIAD：面向多模态大语言模型的全模态歧义基准测试
translated_abstract: 歧义是自然交流的核心特征：一个句子、图像或声音在未考虑其他渠道的证据之前可能仍是欠明确的。然而，当前的多模态基准大多测试对已经确定输入的感知、识别或推理能力，尚不清楚全模态大语言模型能否消解分布于文本、视觉和音频中的歧义。我们提出了TRIAD，一个用于全模态歧义消解的基准。每个条目由一个文本-图像-音频三元组以及一个问题和一组答案选项组成，其构建方式确保完整的三元组能够确定唯一答案，而移除任何一个模态都会使一致选项的集合变得不唯一。TRIAD包含86个场景组中的327条人工编写的查询，覆盖三种模态下的18个歧义类别。对14个全模态系统的评估表明，强大的条目级性能并不能转化为真正的跨模态歧义消解能力。
tldr: 提出了TRIAD——一个全模态歧义消解基准，通过精心构建的文本-图像-音频三元组（只有三者齐全才有唯一答案）测试多模态大语言模型的跨模态歧义消解能力，并揭示现有全模态系统的条目级性能无法等同于真正的歧义消解能力。
en_tdlr: TRIAD is a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution, built from text-image-audio triplets that yield a unique answer only when all three modalities are considered, revealing that the strong item-level performance of current omni-modal LLMs does not translate into genuine cross-modal ambiguity resolution ability.
